description: This file is part of the Logrus logging library for Go, defining log levels, interfaces, and constants for logging functionality.

classes.name: Fields
classes.description: Type alias for a map used to pass structured fields to log entries.

classes.name: Level
classes.description: Type representing log levels as uint32, with methods for string conversion, parsing, and marshaling.

classes.name: StdLogger
classes.description: Interface for standard library loggers compatible with logrus.

classes.name: FieldLogger
classes.description: Interface that generalizes log entries and loggers, providing methods for logging at various levels.

classes.name: Ext1FieldLogger
classes.description: Extension interface for FieldLogger with additional tracing methods.

methods.name: Level.String
methods.description: Converts a Level to its string representation.

methods.name: ParseLevel
methods.description: Parses a string to a Level constant.

methods.name: Level.UnmarshalText
methods.description: Implements decoding from text to a Level.

methods.name: Level.MarshalText
methods.description: Converts a Level to its textual representation.
